# Advanced Memory MCP — Full Reference

FastMCP server for local-first knowledge graph and notes. SQLite FTS5 + LanceDB RAG,
12 managed namespaces, Claude Skills integration, Zettelkasten, and webapp dashboard.

## Architecture

```
Claude / Cursor ← MCP stdio → Advanced Memory Server
                                     ↓
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                    │  SQLite (relational + FTS5)          │
                    │  LanceDB (vector embeddings)          │
                    │  Markdown files (human-readable)      │
                    └──────────────────────────────────────┘
                                     ↓
                              Webapp (port 10704/10705)
```

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Frontend (Vite React) | 10704 |
| Backend (FastAPI + MCP HTTP) | 10705 |
| MCP SSE transport | 10732 |

## MCP Tools

79 tools across 12 managed namespaces. Primary portmanteaus:

- `research_nexus` — Cross-platform retrieval (Search, GitHub, arXiv, TVTropes)
- `adn_content` — CRUD for the Advanced Data Network (knowledge graph)
- `manage_projects` — Context-aware project isolation and workspace indexing
- `rag_search` — Semantic retrieval with cross-reference surfacing
- `memory_diagnostics` — Integrity auditing and graph health verification
- `adn_search` — Text, RAG, and external vault search
- `adn_nav` — Graph traversal and backlink discovery
- `adn_notes` — Note CRUD (write, read, edit, delete, move, quick, daily)
- `adn_skills` — Claude Skills lifecycle management
- `adn_zettel` — Zettelkasten slip-box management
- `adn_audio` — Voice and audio operations
- `adn_automation` — Autonomous batch processing and workflows
- `adn_inbox` — Document ingestion and conversion
- `adn_knowledge` — Intelligence analysis and enhancement
- `adn_system` — Central control plane and orchestration
- `adn_project` — Project lifecycle management
- `adn_typora` — Typora editor integration

## Configuration

Set via `.env`:

| Variable | Purpose | Default |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `ADVANCED_MEMORY_HTTP_PROXY` | HTTP daemon proxy URL | `http://127.0.0.1:10732/mcp` |
| `SYNC_WATCH_DIRS` | Extra directories to watch | — |
| `MCP_TRANSPORT` | Transport mode | `stdio` |
| `MCP_PORT` | HTTP port override | 10732 |

## HTTP Daemon + Stdio Proxy

Persistence (SQLite + LanceDB) is owned by a long-running HTTP daemon. Stdio clients
probe the daemon and become lightweight proxies if it's alive, avoiding DB contention.

## Testing

```powershell
uv run pytest tests/ -q
```
